mapper.select:
SELECT P.* FROM PARTY P
ORDER BY P.PARTY_NAME

SELECT ,
FROM PERSON PRS INNER JOIN PARTY P ON P.PARTY_ID = PRS.PARTY_ID INNER JOIN PARTY_PARENT_ROLE PPR ON PPR.PARTY_ID = PRS.PARTY_ID AND PPR.ROLE_TYPE_ID = 'EMPLOYEE' LEFT JOIN EMPL_POSITION_TYPE EPT ON EPT.EMPL_POSITION_TYPE_ID = PRS.EMPL_POSITION_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN STATUS_ITEM SI ON SI.STATUS_ID = P.STATUS_ID LEFT JOIN PARTY_CONTACT_MECH PCM ON PCM.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID AND PCM.THRU_DATE IS NULL LEFT JOIN CONTACT_MECH CM ON CM.CONTACT_MECH_ID = PCM.CONTACT_MECH_ID WHERE CM.CONTACT_MECH_TYPE_ID = 'EMAIL_ADDRESS' OR CM.CONTACT_MECH_TYPE_ID IS NULL ORDER BY PRS.LAST_NAME, PRS.FIRST_NAME

select distinct V.PP_PARTY_ID as PARTY_ID, V.P_PARTY_NAME as PARTY_NAME from ( select RP.ROLE_TYPE_ID as RP_ROLE_TYPE_ID, RP.DESCRIPTION as RP_DESCRIPTION, RP.SHORT_LABEL as RP_SHORT_LABEL, RP.ICON_CONTENT_ID as RP_ICON_CONTENT_ID, PP.PARENT_ROLE_CODE as PP_PARENT_ROLE_CODE, PP.PARTY_ID as PP_PARTY_ID, P.PARTY_TYPE_ID as P_PARTY_TYPE_ID, P.EXTERNAL_ID as P_EXTERNAL_ID, R.ROLE_TYPE_ID as R_ROLE_TYPE_ID, R.DESCRIPTION as R_DESCRIPTION, R.SHORT_LABEL as R_SHORT_LABEL, R.ICON_CONTENT_ID as R_ICON_CONTENT_ID, P.PARTY_NAME as P_PARTY_NAME, P.PARTY_NAME_LANG as P_PARTY_NAME_LANG, P.FISCAL_CODE as P_FISCAL_CODE, P.VAT_CODE as P_VAT_CODE, P.STATUS_ID as P_STATUS_ID, PE.FIRST_NAME as PE_FIRST_NAME, PE.LAST_NAME as PE_LAST_NAME, PE.EMPL_POSITION_TYPE_ID as PE_EMPL_POSITION_TYPE_ID, PP.ORGANIZATION_ID as PP_ORGANIZATION_ID from ((((PARTY P inner join PARTY_PARENT_ROLE PP on P.PARTY_ID = PP.PARTY_ID) inner join ROLE_TYPE RP on PP.ROLE_TYPE_ID = RP.ROLE_TYPE_ID) inner join PARTY_ROLE PR on PP.PARTY_ID = PR.PARTY_ID and PP.ROLE_TYPE_ID = PR.PARENT_ROLE_TYPE_ID) inner join ROLE_TYPE R on PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID = R.ROLE_TYPE_ID) left outer join PERSON PE on P.PARTY_ID = PE.PARTY_ID) V inner join PARTY_RELATIONSHIP R on V.PP_PARTY_ID = R.PARTY_ID_TO where R.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID in ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') order by V.P_PARTY_NAME asc

SELECT P.* FROM PARTY P INNER JOIN PARTY_ROLE PR ON PR.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID WHERE P.PARTY_TYPE_ID = 'PERSON' AND PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID = #{roleTypeId} AND P.STATUS_ID = 'PARTY_ENABLED' AND P.PARTY_ID IN ( SELECT PREL.PARTY_ID_TO FROM PARTY_RELATIONSHIP PREL INNER JOIN PARTY_ROLE PR2 ON PR2.PARTY_ID = PREL.PARTY_ID_FROM WHERE PREL.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE'
AND
AND ( PR2.ROLE_TYPE_ID IN ( SELECT WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET WHERE WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = #{workEffortTypeId} ) OR PR2.ROLE_TYPE_ID IN ( SELECT WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID2 FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET WHERE WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = #{workEffortTypeId} ) OR PR2.ROLE_TYPE_ID IN ( SELECT WET.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID3 FROM WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET WHERE WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = #{workEffortTypeId} ) )
) ORDER BY P.PARTY_NAME ASC
SELECT PR.* FROM PARTY_ROLE PR WHERE
SELECT P.* FROM PARTY P INNER JOIN PARTY_ROLE PR ON PR.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID WHERE P.PARTY_TYPE_ID = 'PERSON' AND PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID BETWEEN #{roleTypeId0} AND #{roleTypeId1} ORDER BY P.PARTY_NAME

SELECT P.*,
FROM PARTY_ROLE PR INNER JOIN PARTY P ON PR.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID INNER JOIN PARTY_PARENT_ROLE PPR ON PPR.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID
AND PR.PARENT_ROLE_TYPE_ID = 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT' AND P.STATUS_ID = 'PARTY_ENABLED' AND PPR.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{company}
AND
AND PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND
ORDER BY P.EXTERNAL_ID
ORDER BY P.PARTY_NAME_LANG
ORDER BY P.PARTY_NAME
ORDER BY PPR.PARENT_ROLE_CODE

select p.PARTY_ID, pp.PARENT_ROLE_CODE as ppr_parent_role_code, p.PARTY_NAME, p.PARTY_NAME_LANG from party p join party_parent_role pp on pp.party_id = p.party_id where pp.role_type_id = 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT' and pp.organization_id = #{organizationId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 from USER_LOGIN_SECURITY_GROUP ULSG INNER JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.USER_LOGIN_ID = ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID INNER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP PR ON PR.PARTY_ID_TO = UL.PARTY_ID AND PR.PARTY_ID_FROM = p.PARTY_ID AND PR.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID IN ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') AND PR.THRU_DATE IS NULL WHERE ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId})

select p.PARTY_ID, pp.PARENT_ROLE_CODE as ppr_parent_role_code, p.PARTY_NAME, p.PARTY_NAME_LANG from party p join party_parent_role pp on pp.party_id = p.party_id join party_role pr on pr.party_id = p.party_id where pp.role_type_id = 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT' and pp.organization_id = #{organizationId} and pr.role_type_id = #{respCenterRoleTypeId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 from USER_LOGIN_SECURITY_GROUP ULSG INNER JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.USER_LOGIN_ID = ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID INNER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP PR ON PR.PARTY_ID_TO = UL.PARTY_ID AND PR.PARTY_ID_FROM = p.PARTY_ID AND PR.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID IN ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') AND PR.THRU_DATE IS NULL WHERE ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId})
